nodes.title: READ ME FIRST
widgets_values:
# SELECT YOUR MODELS, THEN CLICK GENERATE

This is the complete 6-phase Saya Couple pipeline (sampling, hires / USDU, HiDream refine, pre-detail, detailers, final upscale & naturalize). No model is included: pick your SDXL / Illustrious checkpoints, VAEs, the HiDream models, the upscale model and one detector model per **Detailer 01-13** slot you use (bypass the others with their toggles).

Needs the Saya core patch (`./saya install`) and the custom nodes listed in the README (section *Full workflow*). For a first test, use the simple demo workflow instead.
